_Generated 2026-07-23 by /mol:map (post backend-mirror + cuda-resurrect)._

## Inventory (backend-pillars)

Catalog of `include/atomiverse/` (mirrored impl under `src/`) as of **2026-07-23**, after the **backend-mirror** chain (01–06) and **cuda-resurrect**. Top level is `core/` + `cpu/` + `cuda/` + `torch/` (experimental) + `molrs.hpp`. **No `facade/`**, **no top-level `longrange/` or `potentials/`** — reciprocal-space and pair math are backend-owned. Backend roots hold **directories only** (full English words, mirrored across `cpu/`/`cuda/`; a CPU-only domain is simply absent on CUDA). Namespaces are **not yet** directory-aligned (`ATV::cpu::md::MD` still lives under `cpu/dynamics/`, phase enums under `ATV::md` etc.). CUDA **configures, builds, and links on GH200** (cuda-resurrect complete; residual **cuda-pme-accuracy** debt only).

### Module list

**core / FFI**
- `include/atomiverse/core/` — CUDA-free contracts (precision, units, Frame schema, Driver template, Plan/Stage/Role/Verdict, binding, molrs contract, …)
- `include/atomiverse/molrs.hpp` — stable CXX FFI header (molrs)

**cpu pillars**
- `cpu/frame/` — Frame pillar (blocks + meta + simbox)
- `cpu/driver/` — Driver pillar (loop node, Runtime, criteria, outcome)
- `cpu/component/` — Component pillar (base, kinds, protocols, Context)

**cpu infra**
- `cpu/device/` — DeviceRuntime (OpenMP threads + timing)
- `cpu/communication/` — DomainRuntime (DD, halo, migration, reduce, gather, rcb, bcast)
- `cpu/asynchronous/` — AnalysisRuntime (snapshot ring, async observers)
- `cpu/neighbor/` — CellList / NeighborList / PairList
- `cpu/linalg/` — dense eigensolve / density / matrix helpers
- `cpu/replica/` — ReplicaSet + ReplicaExpansion strategies
- `cpu/task/` — launcher TaskSpec / codec / materializer / WorkerLoop

**cpu domains**
- `cpu/evaluate/` — Evaluate preset + `single_point`
- `cpu/dynamics/` — MD preset + integrators / thermostats / barostats / constraints
- `cpu/montecarlo/` — MC / NptMc / Gcmc + movers + Transaction
- `cpu/minimize/` — Minimize preset + LBFGS / CG + opt recorders
- `cpu/path/` — PathDriver + NEB coupling + REMD skeleton
- `cpu/vibration/` — Hessian preset + FD Hessian / thermochem
- `cpu/scf/` — Gaussian-basis mean-field methods (RHF/UHF/…) + stages + internals
- `cpu/semiempirical/` — AM1 / RM1 / NDDO
- `cpu/planewave/` — PWSolver / PWEvaluator (+ internal FFT/Davidson/…)
- `cpu/gpw/` — GPWSolver / GPWEvaluator + GTH/MOLOPT tables
- `cpu/xc/` — shared Padé LDA
- `cpu/longrange/` — Ewald / PME / PPPM / FMM operator math (backend-owned)
- `cpu/potentials/` — real-space pair + bonded + EAM/SW
- `cpu/bias/` — HarmonicBias + collective variables
- `cpu/observe/` — RDF / MSD / VACF / Virial / Mulliken / density / multipole / …
- `cpu/record/` — Thermo / XYZ / cube / timing report
- `cpu/io/` — extxyz / frame_writer / lammps_data / forcefield (CPU only)

**cuda (mirrors cpu subset; resurrected)**
- `cuda/frame/`, `cuda/driver/`, `cuda/component/`, `cuda/device/`
- `cuda/communication/`, `cuda/neighbor/`, `cuda/asynchronous/`
- `cuda/evaluate/`, `cuda/dynamics/`, `cuda/minimize/`
- `cuda/potentials/`, `cuda/longrange/`, `cuda/observe/`, `cuda/record/`
- `cuda/scf/`, `cuda/planewave/`
- (no cuda twins for: montecarlo, path, vibration, gpw, semiempirical, xc, bias, replica, task, io, linalg)

**torch (experimental skeleton)**
- `torch/frame/`, `torch/component/`, `torch/device/`, `torch/neighbor/`, `torch/potentials/`

**src/** mirrors the same pillar/domain tree for non-header-only translation units (CPU `.cpp`, CUDA `.cu`, torch `.cu`).

### Public surface

**core**
- Precision / IDs: `StorageReal`, `WorkReal`, `AccReal`; `LocalInt`, `TagInt`, `ImageInt`, `BigInt` (`precision.h`)
- Geometry / math: `Mat3`, `Vec3`, `gto`, `real_harmonics`
- Units: public surface eV / Å / fs / amu / eV·Å⁻¹ / K (`units.h`)
- Frame schema keys: `ColKey` / `MetaKey` / `AtomFieldId` / field specs (`frame_schema.h`)
- Driver dispatch: `ATV::Driver<PhaseEnum, DeviceTag>`, `Plan` / `PlanBuilder`, `Stage` phase enums
- Phase enums (typed): `md::Phase`, `minimizer::Phase`, `evaluate::Phase`, `scf::Phase`, `vib::Phase`, `sampling::Phase`, `path::Phase`
- Binding: `PhaseKind`, `DefaultBinding`, `make_binding`, `slot_of` / `slot_count`
- Role / lifecycle: `RoleFlag`, `Scheduling`, `Verdict`, `Outcome`, `ConvergenceMetrics`, `IterationStatus`
- Backend traits tag: `backend_traits<DeviceTag>`
- molrs: version/schema contract (`molrs_contract.h`); FFI via `molrs.hpp`

**cpu pillars**
- **Frame:** `cpu::Frame` (`blocks` + `meta` + `simbox`), `cpu::Box`, `Block` / `Column` / `Span` / `MetaMap`, `materialize` / `write_back`, `to_cuda` transfer
- **Driver:** `cpu::Driver<P>` (loop node + `DriverNode` nesting), `cpu::Runtime` (composes Domain/Device/Analysis runtimes), `OutcomePolicy` / `Metropolis`, shipped criteria `ForceConverged` / `AllReplicasConverged` / `StopOnNaN` (`criteria.h`; `Criterion` kind lives under `component/`)
- **Component:** base `Component` + lifecycle contexts; kind tags `Potential`, `Integrator`, `Thermostat`, `Barostat`, `Optimizer`, `Constraint`, `Mover`, `Observer`, `Recorder`, `Bias`, `PathCoupling`, `PlaneWave`, `GPW`, `Semiempirical`; pure tag `HF` (not a Component — methods are Drivers); protocols `HaloParticipant`, `NeighborConsumer`/`NeighborProvider`, `LongRangeParticipant`, `PairEvaluator`, `ConstraintProvider`; zeros (`ZeroForces`/…); `Context` slices (`md`/`mc`/`opt`/`path`/`loop`/`exec`/`analysis`)

**cpu presets (Driver subclasses)**
- `cpu::Evaluate` — one-pass energy/eval
- `cpu::md::MD` — classical / AIMD
- `cpu::minimizer::Minimize` — geometry opt (+ default `ForceConverged`)
- `cpu::mc::MC` / `NptMc` / `Gcmc` — sampling (+ Metropolis-family outcomes)
- `cpu::PathDriver` — coupled-replica path (+ `AllReplicasConverged`)
- `cpu::vib::Hessian` — FD Hessian + thermochem
- `cpu::scf::{RHF,ROHF,UHF,GHF,RKS,UKS}` — concrete methods; each is `MeanFieldMethod<D>` = `Driver<scf::Phase>` + `HF`; umbrella `methods.h`; compat alias `cpu::scf::SCF = RKS`
- Sugar: `cpu::single_point(frame, method_or_evaluator)` (free function, **not** a class)

**cpu domains (entry types)**
- Dynamics: `VelocityVerlet`, `NVELimit`, `NoseHoover`, `NoseHooverNPT`, `FixLangevin`, `FixCSVR`, `FixRattle`, `Barostat`, `Deform`, `InitVelocity`, `KineticEnergy`, …
- MC: `TranslateMove`, `VolumeMove`, `InsertDeleteMove`, `MoveSelector`, `Transaction`
- Minimize: `LBFGS`, `CG`, `LbfgsHistory`, `OptLog`, `TrajectoryWriter`, `FinalGeometry`
- Path: `NebCoupling`, `BandLBFGS`, `LinearInterpolation` / `IdentityReplication` (via replica/), `Remd` (+ `RemdConfig`)
- Potentials: `PairLJCut`, `PairLJCutCoulLong`, `PairMorse`, `PairCoulCut`, `CoulLong`, `BondHarmonic`, `AngleHarmonic`, `DihedralMultiHarmonic`, `DihedralCharmm`, `ImproperHarmonic`, `EAM`, `StillingerWeber` (+ table-lookup `EAMPotential` / SW tables)
- Longrange: `KSpace` base, `KSpaceEwald`, `KSpacePME`, `KSpacePPPM`, absorbed math (`EwaldSum`, PME spline/influence, FMM tree/ops, `GaussianExtent`)
- Neighbor: `NeighborList<>`, `CellList`, published `PairList`
- Plane-wave: `PWConfig` / `PWResult` / `PWSolver` / `PWEvaluator` (**bag-shaped solver still public**)
- GPW: `GpwConfig` / `GpwResult` / `GPWSolver` / `GPWEvaluator` / `Kind` / `GthPotential` / `GaussianBasis` (**bag-shaped solver still public**)
- Semiempirical: `AM1Evaluator` / `RM1Evaluator` / `AM1BCCChargeAssigner`; bag solvers `NDDOSolver` / `AM1Solver` / `RM1Solver` / `NDDOConfig`
- Observe: `RDF`, `MSD`, `VACF`, `Virial`, Mulliken/Löwdin helpers, ESP charges, multipole, density grid, molrs trajectory accumulators
- Record: `Thermo`, `XYZ`, cube writers, timing report
- I/O: extxyz read, `frame_writer`, LAMMPS data, `ForceField`
- Bias: `HarmonicBias`, `DistanceCV`
- Replica: `ReplicaSet`, `ReplicaExpansion`
- Task: `TaskSpec` / `TaskMaterializer` / `TaskDispatcher` / `WorkerLoop` / `LauncherGate`

- SCF support: `BasisSet` / `AuxBasis`, `XCType`, guess/mixer enums, `SlaterDeterminant`, gradient / MP2 / TDHF / FCI / counterpoise / stages (`fock`/`mix`/`diagonalize`/`density`/`check`)

**cuda (public entry points)**
- Frame: `cuda::Frame` (raw device pointers + host-cached counts; dual topology: flat lists single-GPU / per-atom multi-GPU), `cuda::Box`, `real_t`/`work_t`/`prec_t`, transfer/materialize
- Driver: `cuda::Driver<P>`, `cuda::Backend` (CUDA still has a Backend coordinator — CPU dissolved it), `cuda::Criterion` / `ForceConverged` / `StopOnNaN` (CUDA criterion migration partial; not yet Component-shaped like CPU)
- Component kinds mirrored: `Integrator`, `Optimizer`, `Potential`, `Thermostat`, `Barostat`, `HF` (+ `Component`, `Context` with `md` slice, neighbor/halo protocols)
- Presets: `cuda::md::MD`, `cuda::minimizer::Minimize`, `cuda::Evaluate` (+ `single_point` sugar)
- Dynamics: VelocityVerlet, NVELimit, NoseHoover(NPT), FixLangevin, Barostat, Deform, InitVelocity, zeros, KineticEnergy
- Minimize: LBFGS, CG, SD, ConvCheck
- Potentials: PairLJCut (+ `__host__ __device__` pair kernel), CoulLong, bonded styles
- Longrange: `KSpace`, `KSpaceEwald`, `KSpacePME`
- Neighbor: `NeighborList` / device `PairList`
- SCF: **`cuda::scf::SCFSolver`** (inner bag loop) + **`cuda::scf::SCF`** (HF component owning solver) + workspace; still consumes host `cpu::scf::IntegralPack` on one path
- Plane-wave: `cuda::pw::pw_scf` surface (not a CPU-compatible API)
- Observe/record: RDF (molrs stream), stress, MullikenObs, Thermo, DensityRecorder, AsyncBridge

**torch (experimental)**
- `torch::Frame` (tensor blocks; still older atoms/bonds/… sub-struct layout), materialize/transfer, `NeighborList`, skeleton `LJ` / `HarmonicBond`, `StreamGuard`, minimal `Context`

**Transitional / debt surfaces still on disk**

| Surface | Status (2026-07-23) |

| CPU `SCFSolver` / public `integrals.h` / public `nddo_system.h` | **Tombstones** — headers `#error` redirect to methods / internal |

| `RemdConfig` | Config bag on path REMD skeleton |

### Style summary

- **Naming:** `ATV::` root; backends `cpu` / `cuda` / `torch`; domains often still use short namespaces (`md`, `minimizer`, `sampling`, `path`, `scf`, `pw`, `vib`, `evaluate`) while **directories** are full words (`dynamics/`, `montecarlo/`, `planewave/`, …). File extensions: CPU `.h`/`.cpp`, CUDA `.cuh`/`.cu` (documented CUDA-free bridges keep `.h`: `log_callback.h`, `timer.h`). Internals under `internal/`.
- **Construction:** OOP constructors and member parameters — **no public `make_*` / `build_*` / `*_config()` factories** (grep-gated). Lookup tables are constructors (`GthPotential(Element, name)`, EAM/SW table rows) and **throw** on unsupported input (no silent fallback). Ownership at registration: `add(rvalue)` owns, `add_ref(lvalue)` borrows; plain `add(lvalue)` deleted.
- **Driver model:** A Driver is a **staged loop + Criterion termination + optional OutcomePolicy**; presets only attach defaults in constructors. Nesting via `DriverNode` / `run_nested` on one shared `Runtime` (inner status isolated). Algorithms publish metrics; **only Criterion declares convergence**.
- **Phase typing:** only `ATV::slot_of` / `ctx.at(phase)` / `make_binding` — no hand-written phase→int casts (scrubbed).
- **Frame purity:** sole I/O currency is `blocks + meta + simbox` on CPU; method scratch (integrals, DIIS, AO maps, grids) is **private to the method/solver**, never parked on Frame. Neighbor lists published as non-owning `ctx.md.pair_list`.
- **Component model:** Role bitset (`FrameImmutable` / `Deferred` / `ExternalIO`); kinds for preset validation; opt-in protocols instead of god-virtual Component. Lifecycle `build → launch×N → destroy` (no alloc in `launch`).
- **Dual-backend:** same directory vocabulary; CUDA Frame is device-pointer SoA (legitimately `.atoms`/`.box`/`.scalars` as raw layout); host access only via span/meta/simbox. Precision tiers map 1:1 (`StorageReal`↔`real_t`, …). Kind bases now mirrored on CUDA (post-resurrect).
- **Errors:** throw on contract breaks (schema materialize, unsupported basis/PP name, cross-workflow misbind, missing required kinds). No fallback values in lookup tables.
- **Units:** public eV/Å/fs; SCF/PW internals Hartree/Ry, energy written eV to `frame.meta[kEnergy]`.

### Layer roles

| Module | Role (Architecture vocabulary) |
|---|---|
| `core/` | CUDA-free **contract layer** — precision, schema, Driver template, Plan/Stage/Role/Verdict, device tags |
| `molrs.hpp` | External **FFI boundary** (molrs exchange) |
| `cpu/frame/`, `cuda/frame/` | **Frame pillar** — device-resident state + residency ops / transfer |
| `cpu/driver/`, `cuda/driver/` | **Driver pillar** — loop node, Runtime/Backend coordinator, criteria, outcome |
| `cpu/component/`, `cuda/component/` | **Component pillar** — base, kinds, Context, protocols |
| `cpu/device/`, `cuda/device/` | **Infra — device** (threads/streams/timing) |
| `cpu/communication/`, `cuda/communication/` | **Infra — communication** (DD, halo, migration, multi-GPU) |
| `cpu/asynchronous/`, `cuda/asynchronous/` | **Infra — async analysis** (snapshot ring / AsyncBridge) |
| `cpu/neighbor/`, `cuda/neighbor/`, `torch/neighbor/` | **Infra — neighbor** structures + published PairList |
| `cpu/linalg/` | **Infra — dense linear algebra** (CPU) |
| `cpu/replica/` | **Infra — replica expansion** (one Frame → N coupled replicas) |
| `cpu/task/` | **Infra / app bridge** — serializable task protocol for launcher |
| `cpu/evaluate/`, `cuda/evaluate/` | **Domain — Evaluate** preset |
| `cpu/dynamics/`, `cuda/dynamics/` | **Domain — MD** |
| `cpu/montecarlo/` | **Domain — Monte Carlo** (CPU) |
| `cpu/minimize/`, `cuda/minimize/` | **Domain — geometry optimization** |
| `cpu/path/` | **Domain — path / NEB / REMD** (CPU) |
| `cpu/vibration/` | **Domain — vibrational response** (CPU) |
| `cpu/scf/`, `cuda/scf/` | **Domain — Gaussian SCF** (CPU methods = Driver; CUDA still bag solver) |
| `cpu/semiempirical/` | **Domain — NDDO/AM1** (CPU) |
| `cpu/planewave/`, `cuda/planewave/` | **Domain — plane-wave DFT** |
| `cpu/gpw/` | **Domain — GPW DFT** (CPU) |
| `cpu/xc/` | **Domain — shared XC pieces** (CPU) |
| `cpu/longrange/`, `cuda/longrange/` | **Domain — reciprocal electrostatics** (backend-owned math) |
| `cpu/potentials/`, `cuda/potentials/`, `torch/potentials/` | **Domain — real-space force fields** |
| `cpu/bias/` | **Domain — bias / CV** (CPU) |
| `cpu/observe/`, `cuda/observe/` | **Domain — derived quantities** (Observer) |
| `cpu/record/`, `cuda/record/` | **Domain — I/O recorders** |
| `cpu/io/` | **I/O / molrs bridge** (CPU only) |

### Architecture gates

Grep/CMake gates that pin the pillar layout (ctest-registered):

**`tests/architecture/`**
- `no_factory_scrub.sh` — ban public `make_*` / `build_*` / factory free functions
- `no_toplevel_shared_math_scrub.sh` — no top-level `longrange`/`potentials`; no `cuda/kspace`
- `path_words_scrub.sh` — full-word mirrored backend dirs (no `comm`/`async`/`md`/… abbreviations)
- `driver_names_scrub.sh` — `Driver`/`DriverNode`; no `CPUDriver`/`CUDADriver`/`LoopHandler`
- `no_backend_scrub.sh` — CPU `Backend` dissolved into Domain/Device/Analysis runtimes
- `layout_mirror_scrub.sh` — no `runtime/`/`loop/`/`shared/` dirs; `cuda/* ⊆ cpu/*` vocabulary; tests mirror source dirs
- `docs_vocab_scrub.sh` — docs free of legacy vocabulary
- `cuda_no_stale_api_scrub.sh` — **cuda-resurrect** gate: ban bare `Real`, old unit constants, host-Frame accessor shapes in cuda trees
- `module_dag_auto_enable.cmake` / `module_off_excludes_sources.cmake` / `molrs_contract_mismatch.cmake` — module enablement + molrs pin

**`tests/core/`**
- `no_facade_scrub.sh` — `facade/` gone; contracts under `core/`
- `stage_typing_scrub.sh` — only `slot_of` may cast Phase enums

Related isolation gates live beside domains (e.g. CUDA SCF solver isolation under `tests/cuda/`). Backend-mirror also ships out-of-library consumers under `regressions/layout/`.
